title: Qwen/Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-FP8 TTFT: vLLM baseline on the Metrale TTFT instruments
subtitle: vLLM 0.27.1 + MTP on the Metrale TTFT instruments; no Metrale Engine series in this manifest
aggregate: series: median over 3 runs of each run's median_ms / p90_ms (12 samples per run at 32k; 36 pooled at 256/1024/4096); gate_ceilings: from the steady one-shot pairs
sources_note: Every `sources` key, and every file in oneshot.sources, is a path relative to this manifest's directory; the value is its sha256. The files are the vLLM gate records and one-shot lines exactly as written on the box, copied byte for byte. The one-shot file is JSON Lines named .ndjson because .gitignore drops bench/**/*.jsonl as harness output.

gate_ceilings.rule: owner 2026-09-27: parity with vLLM is the pass bar. The engine's BENCH.toml uses the value below as `max` for both median_ms and p90_ms of the gate. It is vLLM's STEADY one-shot TTFT on the 32k fixture: first-request-after-boot pairs are excluded. Median of the 3 steady pairs over 2 fresh boots.

high-isl-ttft-warm-moe.statistic: median of the steady one-shot warm TTFTs [579.4, 581.8, 566.0]
